title: The error-boundary state renders on a client-side render failure with a role=alert announcement
asA: operator hitting a client-side render exception
iWant: the error-boundary state to render inside role="alert" with a retry recovery hook and no stack detail
soThat: the assistive tech announces the failure immediately (assertive, not polite) and I have an escape from a broken render

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a synthetic client-side render exception thrown via page.evaluate (or the sample-app /probe/error-boundary?crash=1 route), the error-boundary state renders inside role="alert" with a keyboard-reachable [data-recovery="retry"] control, a plain summary line and no stack-frame content matching the sensitive-pattern list. The pack drives /probe/error-boundary?crash=1, reads the region, the retry control and the document text for pattern hits.
The error-boundary state renders under role="alert" so it is announced by screen readers as it appears without requiring focus; the announcement carries the class of failure (never the error stack).
acceptanceCriteria.given: a client-side render exception in a child component
acceptanceCriteria.then: the rendered surface carries role="alert" and the announced text names the class only

acceptanceCriteria.description: When the route-level recovery from an error-boundary fails (a subsequent navigation throws again), the surface renders the outer shell error state and never loops the client-side render exception; a retry counter caps at 3 before surfacing a hard-refresh recommendation.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a repeated failure in the same route
acceptanceCriteria.when: the recovery navigation fires and the render fails again
acceptanceCriteria.then: the outer shell error state renders, no infinite loop occurs and after 3 retries a hard-refresh recommendation appears
